pages.text: Refined Storage is the primary $(t3)T3$() digital storage and autocrafting system.$(br2)$(bold)Dual-path recipes:$() the pack adds a dual-path recipe system for RS components. Tech path uses Mekanism/Thermal materials. Magic path uses Botania/Ars Nouveau materials. Hybrid path (both) gives double yield.$(br2)$(bold)T4 upgrade:$() Advanced RS components (Disk Drives, Pattern Encoders for complex autocrafting) are $(t4)T4$() content. Basic storage is T3.$(br2)$(bold)Setup recommendation:$() Build RS alongside your Mekanism ore processing chain. The autocrafting capability transforms $(t3)T3$() progression speed.$(br2)$(bold)No book needed.$() Refined Storage is documented at $(bold)refinedmods.com/refined-storage$(). In-game, JEI covers all crafting recipes. The system is largely intuitive once the Controller and Disk Drive are placed.
